soc_analyst.title: SOC Analyst (Security Operations Center)
soc_analyst.description: Monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents in real time. The first line of defense.
soc_analyst.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Get Security+ first. Then set up a home lab with a free Splunk license and practice analyzing logs from TryHackMe or a vulnerable VM.

penetration_tester.title: Penetration Tester / Ethical Hacker
penetration_tester.description: Get paid to legally hack systems, networks, and applications to find vulnerabilities before attackers do.
day_to_day: Conduct network and web app pen tests
penetration_tester.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Labs beat certs in this field. Do 50+ machines on TryHackMe/HackTheBox before worrying about OSCP. Build a public GitHub of your writeups.

grc.title: GRC Analyst (Governance, Risk & Compliance)
grc.description: Manage security programs, assess risk, ensure regulatory compliance, and build policies that protect the organization.
grc.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Strong writing and communication skills matter more here than technical skills. Study one framework deeply (start with NIST CSF) and get CISA if you have accounting/audit background.

cloud_security.title: Cloud Security Engineer
cloud_security.description: Design, implement, and monitor security controls for cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
cloud_security.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Pick one cloud provider and go deep. Get your associate-level cloud cert, then the security specialty. Cloud skills pay a significant premium over traditional security roles.
